description: This file defines an interface template for dispatching actions or events within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes a template structure 'IDispatchType' with a specialization for 'void' to handle dispatching with or without an element parameter, and a typedef 'IDispatch' for the 'void' specialization.

classes.name: IDispatchType
classes.description: A template interface for dispatching elements, with specialization for 'void' to handle dispatching without parameters.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Pure virtual method to dispatch an element or perform an action, depending on the specialization.
